message.content: Help pick names for the new semantic dark-mode color tokens we need to add. We have surface, surfaceElevated, separator, accent, and error so far.

content.text: I have a few candidate naming schemes. Which direction do you want to go?

questions.question: Should the new color tokens follow material-style (surface/onSurface) or human-readable (background/foreground) naming?

options.label: Human-readable
options.description: background, foregroundPrimary, foregroundSecondary — more verbose but obvious.
